reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, unit_cost_eur, unit_cost_eur * 1.6 AS shelf_price_eur
FROM products
WHERE (category_id = 15 OR category_id = 16) AND unit_cost_eur < 40
ORDER BY unit_cost_eur, product_id
alternatives: SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, unit_cost_eur, unit_cost_eur + unit_cost_eur * 0.6 AS shelf_price_eur FROM products WHERE category_id IN (15, 16) AND unit_cost_eur < 40.00 ORDER BY 4, 1
